items.title: Why J. M. Smucker (SJM) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of packaged foods company J.M Smucker (NYSE:SJM) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter earnings and sales that exceeded Wall Street estimates and raised its full-year profit forecast. According to a company press release, J. M. Smucker generated second-quarter net sales of $2.22 billion, up 5% year on year. This topped Wall Street consensus estimates of $2.13 billion, supported by net price increases and a 1% rise in sales volumes across key brands
